content_md: Saw the Elizabeth Holmes / Nathan Fielder movie You Can See Everything yesterday. Very good as reviews say. Ir reminded me of Orson Welles' F for Fake in the way it used the medium to play with different levels of simulation. Holmes' obvious psychopathology pairs well with Fielder's relentless interrogating of basic human interaction.
